title: Cost center pool blocks usage
summary: Enable a cost center AI credit pool and show usage stopping when the included pool cap is reached.

steps.title: Consume most cost center credits
steps.description: Alice consumes 3,800 of the AI Innovation cost center's 3,900 included credits.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool, leaving 100 credits.

steps.title: Try to exceed the pool cap
steps.description: Alice tries to consume 200 more AI credits after only 100 remain in the cost center pool.
steps.expected: The simulator blocks the event because this cost center is configured to block at the included-pool cap.
